spec.situation_desc: is frustrated that their branch closed and phone waits are long

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Sam speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I’m Bartek Pemberton. I’m really fed up that my branch has closed, and every time I ring I’m stuck waiting ages. It feels like the bank just doesn’t care.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry you’ve been left feeling that way, Bartek. I can understand why the closure and the long waits are frustrating.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: It’s just not good enough. I want someone at the bank to know how unhappy I am.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Of course. I’ll log this as a complaint about the branch closure and the time you’ve had to wait on the phone.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: All right. What happens once you’ve done that?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll submit it to our complaints team today. They’ll look into the points you’ve raised and send you a full written response within eight weeks.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Can you tell me now whether anything’s going to change?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can’t promise what the outcome will be, but I’ll make sure your concerns are included for the team to review.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Okay. I don’t want this to just disappear, though.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand. I’ll take ownership of getting the complaint submitted today, and I’ll call you by 5 pm tomorrow to confirm it’s been logged and give you the reference.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Thanks, I appreciate you following up.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Just to check I’ve explained it clearly: I’m logging this as a complaint today, I’ll call by 5 pm tomorrow with the reference, and the complaints team will send a full written response within eight weeks. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks, Bartek. I’m sorry again about the experience, and I’ll make sure this is passed on.
